categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the mobile communication technology services sector, offering network optimization services, communication network engineering, network design and planning, and network maintenance. It also develops and sells related products, including system products and virtual reality digital content. The company has expanded into overseas markets such as Thailand and Sri Lanka and is exploring 5G-enabled industry applications and virtual reality businesses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced mobile communication technologies including 5G and 5G-A networks, cloud computing, AI, XR (extended reality), and digital twin technologies. It employs comprehensive network optimization techniques covering wireless network testing, base station configuration, frequency planning, and performance optimization. The company also develops proprietary network big data analysis systems and immersive VR content based on licensed IPs, utilizing UWB positioning and real-time interactive VR technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major telecommunications operators such as China Mobile, Huawei, and ZTE, which together account for a significant portion of the company's revenue. The company serves telecom operators, equipment manufacturers, and is expanding into digital economy sectors including government and enterprise markets. It also targets emerging markets in Southeast Asia and virtual reality entertainment consumers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, with strong presence in economically developed regions like East China and North China. It has also established overseas subsidiaries and operations in Thailand, Sri Lanka, Hong Kong, South Africa, and Myanmar, expanding its international footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the telecommunications supply chain, providing third-party technical services including network optimization, engineering, and maintenance. It acts as a service integrator between telecom operators and equipment manufacturers, without engaging in manufacturing of core telecom hardware.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening mobile communication service capabilities, advancing 5G and 5G-A network applications, and integrating digital twin and XR technologies. The company invests heavily in R&D focused on network optimization, immersive VR experiences, UWB positioning, and integrated ticketing systems for VR entertainment. It aims to become a leading integrated mobile communication technology service provider and expand into new digital economy sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through service contracts obtained via bidding processes, including network optimization and engineering services. Additional revenue streams include sales of system products, rental income from properties, and emerging virtual reality content and experience services. The company also earns investment income and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the longest-established and largest third-party professional network optimization service providers in China, with a strong market position and stable cooperation with major telecom operators and equipment vendors. It faces intense competition in a fragmented and highly competitive industry, with risks from customer concentration and technological upgrades.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately 691 million RMB, a slight decline of 2.06% year-over-year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about 78.48 million RMB, reflecting a significant profit decline. The company has total assets near 970 million RMB and equity of about 580 million RMB. R&D investment increased by 25.79% to over 38 million RMB. The company’s cash flow from operations was negative, indicating liquidity pressures.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its extensive experience and technical expertise in network optimization across multiple generations of mobile networks (2G to 5G), offering comprehensive and customized solutions. It combines service and product offerings, including proprietary big data analysis systems and immersive VR content, to provide differentiated, integrated solutions. Its broad geographic coverage and stable relationships with major customers further strengthen its competitive advantage.
